title: Clean ground transportation goal.
bodyText: The department of transportation, in collaboration with the Hawaii state energy office, shall develop strategies to transition all light-duty motor vehicles in the State's fleets to meet the clean ground transportation goal established pursuant to section 196-9(c)(10).
bodyHtml:
[§264-20.7]  Clean ground transportation goal.  The department of transportation, in collaboration with the Hawaii state energy office, shall develop strategies to transition all light-duty motor vehicles in the State's fleets to meet the clean ground transportation goal established pursuant to section 196-9(c)(10). [L 2021, c 74, §3]
